title: RQP patch envelope (rqp/1, HTTP)
description: Normative text: docs/engineering/protocol/manifest-patch.md section 2. Since H-104 and H-107 the envelope is the binding and the operations; the client computes the block hash of each content and the next page revision R', and checks the binding of the URL, its base revision, the nonce of its request (H-108) and R' (section 2.4, step 7). Unknown members, also the members of the envelope before H-104 (type, protocol, base_revision, template_revision, op, format, sha256) and next_revision of the envelope of H-104 (replaced by H-107), make the envelope invalid. The schema does not check rules that need more than one value or the client state: block ids known, unique and in document order, the binding recomputation, content rules, byte sizes, duplicate member names.

operations.description: rqp/1 has one operation: replace the content of a block (H-47). The operation has no op member (H-104); a new operation needs a new capability and a new envelope form.

content.description: New block content. maxLength counts code points; the client also checks the UTF-8 byte length (maxBlockBytes).

binding.description: Delta binding value (H-107, H-108): d1. and B64U(SHA-256("rqp-d1" LF U LF B LF N LF R' LF)), canonical base64url (manifest-patch section 1.3, rule 2). N is the client nonce of the request (the field Rq-Nonce, H-109).
